method_words: silver_locations() takes one day argument; the read used the placeholder day 2000-01-03 and kept the prefix, as the checker does; no AWS call is made by that function. Every live read is a LIST (list_objects_v2 with a delimiter) or a GET of one parquet, through one read-only reader class. Two runs of the same read-only script were made; the reads block is the cumulative count of both runs.

reporting_gold.evidence_words: The scheduled handler takes its firm from the first custody entry of its sources.json; that file holds one custody entry, keyed by a registry master that resolves to a firm other than cottonwood, and no cottonwood key. Its filled-report households call is the built-in firm adapter, which reads that firm's household crosswalk, not the Cottonwood account_dim. The schedule file fires only this handler and carries no cottonwood event.
reporting_gold.absent_kinds_words: Cottonwood holds no account_activity_daily gold table, no account_lot_realized gold table, no account_lot_unrealized_daily gold table and no account_class_daily gold table; the reader names each of the four as the absent form NO_SOURCE_YET until one exists.

silver_to_gold_holdings.words: Silver fact_holdings and the Cottonwood holdings_performance_daily gold both newest-land on 2026-10-14; the gold holds 1001 rows and 1001 distinct accounts. Row-level tie to silver was not compared; the verdict rests on the newest partition.

silver_to_gold_account_dim.words: Silver fact_allocations and fact_holdings both newest-land on 2026-10-14; the Cottonwood account_dim gold newest-lands on 2026-10-14 with 1004 rows. Its account set is the holdings set plus 3 accounts with no holding (only_in_account_dim 3).

gold_to_reporting_gold_households.words: The Cottonwood reader's households() would take the 2026-10-14 account_dim partition and return 226 households, but the scheduled reporting-gold build never calls it for Cottonwood: its firm and households come from the built-in firm's crosswalk. The scheduled_for_cottonwood value is false.

reporting_gold_output.words: The scheduled build writes no Cottonwood filled report: output_prefix is null and a Cottonwood gold prefix has no writer in the build. The output object count is 0 by construction, not by a listing.
